prompt: A compound with molecular formula C₆H₅NO₂ gives the IR below. Identify the main functional group.

options.label: Nitro group (two strong bands at ~1520 and ~1345 cm⁻¹, asym + sym N-O)
Primary amide (C=O ~1660 + two N-H bands at 3300-3500)
Nitrile (sharp band at ~2250 cm⁻¹ for C≡N)
Primary amine with carbonyl impurity (N-H bands + C=O at 1715)

explanation: The ArNO₂ group has TWO characteristic strong bands: ~1520 (asymmetric N-O stretch) and ~1345 (symmetric N-O stretch) cm⁻¹. These are hard to miss and don't overlap with anything else. Nitriles show C≡N at 2250, not nitro's 1520+1345. Nitrobenzene formula C₆H₅NO₂ fits — only one N, two O's.
